# To-Do List App

## Quick Start (No Installation Required)

Since Node.js/npm is not available on your system, I've created a **standalone HTML version** that works immediately:

### Option 1: Open Directly in Browser
1. Navigate to the `todo-list-app` folder
2. Double-click `standalone-todo.html`
3. The app will open in your default browser and work immediately!

## Features

✅ Add new tasks
✅ Mark tasks as complete/incomplete (click on task)
✅ Delete tasks (click X button)
✅ Filter tasks (All, Active, Completed)
✅ Clear all completed tasks
✅ Task counter
✅ Beautiful, modern UI
✅ Responsive design
✅ Data persists in browser (localStorage)

## React Version (Requires Node.js)

If you install Node.js later, you can run the React version:

```bash
npm install
npm run dev
```

The React app is located in the `src` folder with:
- `src/App.jsx` - Main React component with full to-do functionality
- `src/App.css` - Styling
- `src/main.jsx` - React entry point

## Files Created

- `standalone-todo.html` - **Use this file** - Complete to-do app in a single HTML file
- `src/App.jsx` - React version of the to-do app
- `src/App.css` - Styling for React version
- `package.json` - Dependencies (fixed JSON syntax error)
- `vite.config.js` - Vite configuration
- `index.html` - React app HTML template

## Notes

The standalone version uses vanilla JavaScript and includes all the same features as the React version. It's production-ready and works in all modern browsers!
